window: Past 24 hours. Search indexes lagged; two verifiable US local stories surfaced, with no new federal, South America, SOUTHCOM strike or rest-of-world items confirmed.

stories.headline: Montgomery police report a month-long operation netting about $1 million in drugs and six arrests
stories.body: At a briefing on 29 October, Montgomery, Alabama police said the four-week push recovered 140 lb of marijuana, 5.5 lb of crystal meth, 1.5 lb of fentanyl and 172 g of cocaine. Six people have been arrested and the department expects more as the investigation continues.

stories.headline: Bismarck apartment-building meth ring leads to three charged after warrant turns up 1.4 kg
stories.body: Court documents say a search warrant carried out on a Tuesday, likely 27 October, at a North 2nd Street building in Bismarck, North Dakota, recovered over 1,400 g of methamphetamine, pills, scales, sealing equipment and a large amount of cash. Three people face conspiracy and possession-with-intent charges.
